content_units: Week-at-a-Glance Plan

Here is a practical Berlin-time schedule for   2026-02-09 to 2026-02-13   that fits all fixed commitments, keeps lunch daily, places the dentist during business hours, and avoids more than   2 meetings in a row  .
Scheduled Week Breakdown
Day   Time   Plan   Notes
Mon 2026-02-09   08:30-09:00   Weekly setup + inbox triage   Light start before meetings
Mon 2026-02-09   09:00-10:00   Team standup   Fixed
Mon 2026-02-09   10:15-12:15   Deep work: Product spec   2h focus block
Mon 2026-02-09   12:15-12:45   Lunch   Daily lunch
Mon 2026-02-09   12:45-14:15   Proposal draft   1.5h
Mon 2026-02-09   14:30-15:00   1:1 with manager   Meeting kept separate from standup
Mon 2026-02-09   15:00-16:30   Proposal draft   Finishes 3h total
Mon 2026-02-09   16:30-17:30   Admin buffer / follow-ups   Flexible overflow slot
Tue 2026-02-10   08:30-10:30   Deep work: Product spec   2h focus block
Tue 2026-02-10   10:45-11:30   Expense report   45m complete
Tue 2026-02-10   11:30-12:00   Email/admin   Low-intensity buffer
Tue 2026-02-10   12:00-12:30   Lunch   Daily lunch
Tue 2026-02-10   13:00-14:30   Client call   Fixed
Tue 2026-02-10   15:00-16:00   Dentist appointment   Business hours
Wed 2026-02-11   08:30-10:30   Deep work: Product spec   Final 2h; completes 4h total
Wed 2026-02-11   10:30-12:00   Spec notes / decision log / buffer   Keeps day realistic
Wed 2026-02-11   12:00-12:30   Lunch   Daily lunch
Wed 2026-02-11   13:00-14:30   Open work block   Catch-up or overflow
Wed 2026-02-11   15:00-16:00   Therapy   Fixed
Wed 2026-02-11   16:00-17:30   Light tasks only   Good cooldown after appointment
Thu 2026-02-12   09:00-11:00   Workshop   Fixed
Thu 2026-02-12   11:15-12:15   Follow-up notes / action items   Good post-workshop slot
Thu 2026-02-12   12:15-12:45   Lunch   Daily lunch
Thu 2026-02-12   13:00-15:00   Focus block / overflow reserve   Protects week from slippage
Thu 2026-02-12   15:00-17:30   Shallow work / prep for review   Lower cognitive load
Fri 2026-02-13   08:30-10:30   Finish leftovers / polish deliverables   Best kept flexible
Fri 2026-02-13   12:00-12:30   Lunch   Daily lunch
Fri 2026-02-13   13:00-15:30   Weekly wrap-up work block   Documentation, email, prep
Fri 2026-02-13   16:00-17:00   Review   Fixed
Fri 2026-02-13   17:00-17:30   Next-week planning   Clean close to week
Triage Highlights
-   Most focus-heavy work is front-loaded   to Mon-Wed, when it is easiest to protect uninterrupted time.
-   Proposal draft   is finished Monday, reducing deadline pressure early.
-   Product spec deep work   is split into two 2-hour blocks on Tue/Wed plus one 2-hour block Mon, with only   4h required   and extra related buffer available.
-   Meetings are spaced   so you do not exceed your preferred limit of 2 in a row.
-   Dentist   is placed Tuesday after the client call, leaving enough recovery and admin space.
-   Gym   is scheduled after 17:30 on Tue and Thu as requested.
Quick Adjustments if the Week Slips
- If Monday gets disrupted, move   16:30-17:30 Monday + 13:00-14:30 Wednesday   to proposal overflow.
- If the dentist only has another slot,   Thursday 15:00-16:00   is the cleanest backup.
- If the workshop generates many actions, use   Friday 08:30-10:30   as the first recovery block.
Planning Notes for This Schedule
- Lunch is set for   30 minutes each day  .
- I treated therapy, workshop, review, standup, and client call as meeting-style commitments.
- I kept a few buffers intentionally so the plan stays usable rather than overpacked.
